the biocide triclocan can select for the emergence of antibiotic resistance through the binding of the repressor Smet, the regulator of smeDEF, an efflux pump involved in the removal of antibiotics from the cell.

the widely used antibacterial agent triclosan induces the expression of the multidrug efflux system SmeDEF in Stenotorphomonas maltophilia, thus reducing the sensitivity of the bacteria to antibiotics in its presence.

the impact of biocides on the development of antibiotic resistance in bacteria.
